name: Strawberry 20:1 CBD + Hybrid Enhanced Gummies
description:
Our Strawberry 20:1 CBD:THC gummies are made with real fruit, a Hybrid terpene blend, and enhanced with cannabis-derived CBD oil. Perfect for relaxing your body while keeping your mind sharp and alert. They are the go-to gummy if you are looking to decompress or take the edge off. It’s a little like a spa treatment for your body and soul. Enjoy!

200mg CBD:10mg THC per package, 20mg CBD:1mg THC per gummy.
